outroLine: How many did you get? Comment your score below, and subscribe with the bell on for a new quiz every day!

lines.q: Fifty geography questions, from easy to legend, and they get harder every round. Keep score! First one: which country is shaped like a boot?
lines.a: Italy! And Sicily is the ball it's kicking.

lines.q: In which city will you find the Eiffel Tower?
lines.a: Paris! It was built for the World's Fair in eighteen eighty nine.

lines.q: On which continent is Egypt?
lines.a: Africa! Although a small corner of it, the Sinai, reaches into Asia.

lines.q: What is the capital of Germany?
lines.a: Berlin! It has more bridges than Venice.

lines.q: Easy so far? Which country has a maple leaf on its flag?
lines.a: Canada! That flag only became official in nineteen sixty five.

lines.q: Which river flows through London?
lines.a: The Thames! The Seine is the one in Paris.

lines.q: Kangaroos live in the wild on which continent?
lines.a: Australia! A group of kangaroos is called a mob.

lines.q: What is the capital of Russia?
lines.a: Moscow! Saint Petersburg was the capital for about two hundred years, though.

lines.q: In which country is Mount Fuji?
lines.a: Japan! It's actually an active volcano.

lines.q: Last one of round one. Which US state is made up entirely of islands?
lines.a: Hawaii! It's the only state outside North America.

lines.q: Round two: medium, and it gets harder now. What is the capital of South Korea?
lines.a: Seoul! Pyongyang is the capital of North Korea.

lines.q: What is the capital of Ireland?
lines.a: Dublin! Belfast is the capital of Northern Ireland, part of the UK.

lines.q: Which Italian city is famous for its gondolas?
lines.a: Venice! The city is built on more than a hundred small islands.

lines.q: Turkey lies on which two continents?
lines.a: Europe and Asia! Istanbul sits on both sides of the Bosphorus.

lines.q: Nice going! What is the capital of Argentina?
lines.a: Buenos Aires! The name means good winds.

lines.q: Marrakesh is a city in which country?
lines.a: Morocco! But the capital is Rabat, not Marrakesh.

lines.q: Which is the largest country in the world by area?
lines.a: Russia! It covers more than a tenth of all the land on Earth.

lines.q: The Panama Canal links the Atlantic to which ocean?
lines.a: The Pacific! Ships save thousands of miles instead of sailing around South America.

lines.q: Madagascar lies in which ocean?
lines.a: The Indian Ocean! Most of its animals live nowhere else on Earth.

lines.q: The United States shares the world's longest border between two countries with which country?
lines.a: Canada! Almost nine thousand kilometers long.

lines.q: Round three: hard. Ready? What is the longest mountain range on land?
lines.a: The Andes! About seven thousand kilometers down South America.

lines.q: Which of these South American countries is landlocked?
lines.a: Bolivia! Paraguay is the only other one on the continent.

lines.q: Which is the longest river in the United States?
lines.a: The Missouri! It beats the Mississippi by just a tiny margin. Did that get you?

lines.q: Which strait separates Europe and Africa?
lines.a: The Strait of Gibraltar! At its narrowest it's only about fourteen kilometers wide.

lines.q: Angel Falls, the tallest waterfall on Earth, is in which country?
lines.a: Venezuela! The water drops nearly a kilometer. If you're enjoying this, subscribe and turn on the bell!

lines.q: The Atacama, one of the driest places on Earth, is mostly in which country?
lines.a: Chile! Some weather stations there have never recorded rain.

lines.q: The Danube flows into which sea?
lines.a: The Black Sea! On the way, it passes through four capital cities.

lines.q: Halfway through round three! The Gobi Desert covers parts of China and which country?
lines.a: Mongolia! And it gets snow in winter.

lines.q: Where is the lowest point on dry land?
lines.a: The shore of the Dead Sea! More than four hundred meters below sea level.

lines.q: Which river forms much of the border between the United States and Mexico?
lines.a: The Rio Grande! In Mexico, it's called the Río Bravo.

lines.q: Round four: very hard. This is where scores drop. What is the capital of Croatia?
lines.a: Zagreb! Ljubljana is Slovenia and Belgrade is Serbia.

lines.q: What is the capital of Kenya?
lines.a: Nairobi! It even has a national park right inside the city.

lines.q: Which major river crosses the equator twice?
lines.a: The Congo! It's also the deepest river in the world.

lines.q: What is the capital of Bhutan?
lines.a: Thimphu! It's one of the few capitals without a single traffic light.

lines.q: Still with me? Timbuktu is a real city. In which country?
lines.a: Mali! It was a famous center of learning in the fifteenth century.

lines.q: The Caspian Sea is really the world's largest what?
lines.a: Lake! It has no connection to the ocean, but its water is slightly salty.

lines.q: What is the capital of Myanmar?
lines.a: Naypyidaw! Yangon, the old capital, is still its biggest city.

lines.q: Which country was once called Abyssinia?
lines.a: Ethiopia! It's also where coffee is said to have been discovered.

lines.q: What was Sri Lanka called until nineteen seventy two?
lines.a: Ceylon! That's why you still see Ceylon tea in the shops.

lines.q: What is the smallest country in South America?
lines.a: Suriname! And its official language is Dutch.

lines.q: Final round: legend level. Only real geography pros survive this. What is the capital of Burkina Faso?
lines.a: Ouagadougou! Locals just call it Ouaga.

lines.q: Which is the driest continent on Earth?
lines.a: Antarctica! Its high interior gets only about two inches of snow a year.

lines.q: Lesotho is completely surrounded by which country?
lines.a: South Africa! It's one of only three countries fully inside another.

lines.q: What is the largest landlocked country in the world?
lines.a: Kazakhstan! It's the ninth largest country on Earth.

lines.q: Which is the southernmost capital city in the world?
lines.a: Wellington, in New Zealand! It's also one of the windiest.

lines.q: Which of these countries is doubly landlocked, surrounded only by landlocked countries?
lines.a: Liechtenstein! Uzbekistan is the only other one.

lines.q: Three left, stay with me! Which is the largest island in the Mediterranean?
lines.a: Sicily! It's home to Etna, the tallest active volcano in Europe.

lines.q: In which country does the Mekong River begin?
lines.a: China! High up on the Tibetan Plateau.

lines.q: Greenland is part of which kingdom?
lines.a: Denmark! But Greenland governs most of its own affairs.

lines.q: Final question. Which is the northernmost of these capitals: Reykjavík, Oslo, Helsinki or Stockholm?
lines.a: Reykjavík! The northernmost capital of any country. On winter days, the sun shines for only about four hours.
